public_interfaces.purity: pure, deterministic, no config/filesystem/network/clock, no company special-casing
public_interfaces.locator_policy: no locator is ever allocated; the output wire contains no locator field

interface_deviations: group.kind limited to the seven kinds in review/INTERFACES.md section 5; a table header is a table_row group whose basis contains header_row/header_block
column_lane groups are emitted per page (cuts are learned document-wide so sparse pages reuse sibling gutter evidence); unit_hints.text_column uses the document-wide cut set
relations target the table_region group (header_for/caption_for/footnote_for) or the next table_region (continuation); a footnote under a figure may point at the figure's caption group instead
cells.row_span is currently always null (row spanning is not claimed); column_span counts covered column slots
diagnostic code WORK_UNITS (detail = accumulated work count) is an informational entry added for budget observability
additive diagnostics: CONTINUATION_CLAIMED, MISSING_GEOMETRY, UNORDERABLE_UNIT, LOGICAL_ROW_UNRESOLVED, NEEDS_UPSTREAM_GRANULARITY

input_geometry_requirements: unit_id/ordinal: stable, unique, bound to the caller's own source units
bbox: span/cell level [x0,y0,x1,y1] in a single page coordinate system (NOT one bbox per wrapped row)
page/width/height: physical page number plus page size in the same unit as bbox
font_size: absolute size (pt or frontend-equivalent scale)
locator: existing opaque parser locator, passed through untouched
minimum for column recovery: >=2 quantity rows whose cells carry their own bbox; a unit wrapping a whole row cannot prove column membership
unsupported_carriers: HTML: current document_normalization html_parser emits no bbox/font_size -> no real-geometry assertion; needs_upstream (DOM geometry passthrough)
PPT: current pptx_parser emits no bbox/font_size -> needs_upstream (shape geometry passthrough)
DOCX: same as PPT (no geometry emitted today)
scanned/OCR pages: no pixel or OCR reading in this package; pages without geometry degrade to text-only hints
ambiguity_and_partial_conditions: whole-row single units -> table region low + NEEDS_UPSTREAM_GRANULARITY, cells=[] (never fabricate columns from whitespace)
wrapped logical rows / interleaved multi-line cells -> LOGICAL_ROW_UNRESOLVED, affected rows capped at medium
table without a header row -> no header_for relation, region confidence capped at medium
quantity-less text table -> at most the first band is treated as header, the rest are rows
bilingual pages that are not sentence-aligned -> lane hints only, no sentence pairing
footnote below a figure -> attaches to the caption group above, never to the table below
budget/limit exhaustion -> coverage.complete=false plus deferred_unit_ids (UNIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED / WORK_BUDGET_EXCEEDED / GROUP_LIMIT_EXCEEDED)
missing font_size -> heading confidence capped at medium (a short line alone is never high)

complexity.shape: per-page banding O(n log n); cells and runs are local; column slots cluster intervals only; cross-page continuation checks are bounded to edge regions
complexity.budget: limits tighten-only; default max_units=50000, max_groups=10000, max_work_units=2000000

known_gaps: not wired to production: no parser/section/selector consumes this package yet; recall or summary quality is NOT claimed to be fixed by it
logical-row recovery for interleaved wrapped cells is deliberately partial (flagged, not guessed)
real-geometry carriers limited to what PyMuPDF sampling in tests provides; HTML/PPT/DOCX geometry passthrough is ROOT work
no real 50000-unit original was run at the default ceilings; only synthetic scale was observed
the p61 overview table tail and similar wrapped quantity-less tables may be reported as unclaimed bands rather than one region

resources.notes: no vendor call, no new dependency; PyMuPDF/ruff were already installed; scratch stayed in %TEMP% and in the lane's own .planning directory

raw_preservation: 4 real originals read-only; SHA-256 and mtime identical before and after the C-node runs; no original copied into the repository
scratch_restore: no scratch artifacts remain inside the worktree; probe mapping evidence is bounded (quotes <=8 KiB per source) and a probe id is never presented as a production locator
next_root_action: Wire derive_layout_hints into the existing parser path: pass span-level bbox/font_size/font_weight and the caller's own locator through the format frontends, map unit_hints.heading_level/text_column and groups/relations onto the existing hints/section structures, and delete the duplicated column/heading inference that this package replaces. Treat NEEDS_UPSTREAM_GRANULARITY as a frontend granularity gap and coverage.complete=false as a partial-coverage signal downstream.
